entry.title: Day 11: Understanding `break` and `continue` Statements in Java
entry.summary:
What are break and continue?
In Java, break and continue are loop control statements. change the normal flow of loops (for, while, do-while, and switch). break → stops the loop completely continue → skips the current iteration and moves to the next one break Statement
What is break?
The break statement is used to terminate a loop immediately when a specific condition is met. Once break is executed: The loop stops Control moves to the statement after the loop
Syntax of break
break;
break in a loop
for (int i = 1; i <= 10; i++) { if (i == 5) { break; } System.out.println(i); }
1 2 3 4
